# Cletus Treasure Hunt

> A nationwide deal-hunting service. Twice a day we scan Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, eBay and public auction houses across the United States, filter out junk and sold listings, and email customers a short list of live, on-target deals with direct links. Read-only scouting: we never contact sellers, bid, or spend on a customer's behalf.

## Service
- Name: Cletus Treasure Hunt
- Provider: Cletus Advanced Solutions
- Area served: United States (all 50 states; customer-set search radius from local pickup to nationwide-and-ship)
- Model: You name a target, we scan 12+ marketplaces and auction houses twice daily and email a curated short list of live listings with direct links and why-it's-a-deal notes.

## Pricing
- First find: free (no match in 7 days, you pay nothing)
- Single Hunt: $49 one-time (one target)
- Standard: $99/month (up to 3 targets, 2x/day scan)
- Pro: $199/month (6 targets, auction coverage, bid math)
- Local Business: $299/month (equipment sourcing for businesses)

## Sources scanned
- Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, eBay
- Public auction houses: GovDeals, Municibid, HiBid and others

## What it will NOT do
- It does not contact sellers
- It does not place bids
- It does not spend money on a customer's behalf
- Every purchase decision stays with the customer
